response.sql: WITH product_volumes AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as product_volume FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), total_volume AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as total_vol FROM Order_Items), product_shares AS (SELECT pv.product_id, pv.product_volume, pv.product_volume / tv.total_vol as share FROM product_volumes pv CROSS JOIN total_volume tv), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM product_shares) SELECT SUM(ps.product_volume) as combined_order_volume, AVG(ps.share) as average_share, AVG(ps.share - ashr.avg_share) as average_excess_above_average FROM product_shares ps CROSS JOIN average_share ashr WHERE ps.share > ashr.avg_share
